<!-- uv-lifecycle-closure: recipe-entrypoint-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: execution-plan-retirement -->

## Goal

Perform the mechanical D-038 post-merge lifecycle closure for `recipe-entrypoint-retirement` after PR #91 merged as `050780d013276c3d3de9672244ad54da759f1ed3` from exact reviewed HEAD `6218437f78d6d8b842cda1d01f8c675147446513`.

## Changes

- transition `project-context/ACTIVE_SLICE.json` from `review` to `idle` with `active_slice: null`;
- record `recipe-entrypoint-retirement` / PR #91 / merge `050780d013276c3d3de9672244ad54da759f1ed3` as `last_completed`;
- synchronize `PROJECT_STATE.md` with the accepted recipe-entrypoint retirement result and final review/CI/merge evidence;
- set the single next handoff to `execution-plan-retirement` and synchronize `NEXT_TASK.md` to that bounded D-070 scope.

No runtime, test, schema, API, frontend or product behavior changes are included.

## Verification

PR #91 received the required genuinely fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review for exact `1068694fac69eb02ff6e0651855c875c532e31a7..6218437f78d6d8b842cda1d01f8c675147446513`, returning `CURRENT / PASS / 0 findings / 6 rejected candidates` under immutable BASE `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` v1.0.

Final merge-authoritative CI #4810 (`33894022998`) passed all five permanent checks on exact reviewed HEAD `6218437f78d6d8b842cda1d01f8c675147446513`, including both full unit suites, API integration, Stage4A real-media, frontend lint/audit/build and browser Product Truth on Ubuntu and Windows. PR #91 was then merged with `expected_head_sha` fixed to that reviewed HEAD.

Require the repository's five permanent CI checks on exact closure head `91885b0195e9b3e47b172d5c8631e296c674dbf6` before merge. This is a mechanical lifecycle/context closure and does not require a new independent semantic review.

## Architecture impact

None. This PR records the already-merged D-070 retirement result and returns repository development memory to canonical `idle`; it introduces no new application authority.

## Known limitations

This closure does not execute `/execution-plan` retirement, legacy `/projects/{id}` migration, Product Orchestrator retirement, Stage8 retirement or later D-070 work. Those remain separate bounded slices.

## Next task

After this closure merges and `main` is verified lifecycle-idle, rerun the mandatory fresh bootstrap and repository-skill discovery from that exact `main`, then open `execution-plan-retirement`. Exact-scan `/api/uv/projects/{id}/execution-plan`, `projectsApi#getProjectExecutionPlan()` and all callers, replace supported readiness with direct Production/Generation/Capability authority, and preserve remaining compatibility consumers until their own accepted retirement slices.
